HB24/134 support lubrication through link holes and upward-facing upper-run openings; HB132 supplies the split-pin size. The selected two passages per bar, 3.175 mm hole diameter, tail bend radius and angle remain explicit reconstruction assumptions.
Formed cotter legs retain the 44.45 mm nominal centerline length. The overlapping round-leg proxy gains 0.672616 cubic mm when splayed; it is not an exact material-conserving forming model.

These are static geometric clearance and retention checks. Lubrication performance, strength, continuous running engagement, source inventory reconciliation and full-model integration remain unqualified.
